logline: Barça and Real play tug of war for the LaLiga trophy: Real's 9 straight wins move it 0 cm, Barça nearly lose it at 0-2 then yank it back, both stars let go to miss penalties, and the gap stays 36-33.

Yamal lets go to take a penalty — wide; Raphinha alone on the rope
